usedFor: Qminder runs the visitor queue and Google Docs keeps the record when “visitor checks in” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “visitor checks in” in Qminder, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each check-in adds a line to a log tab, so front-desk history sits in one doc.

watchOut: “Add visitor to queue” and “visitor checks in” both fire for one visitor, so a log can get two lines.
